answer: Vesting with clawback: each epoch's reward releases over 8 epochs, 12.5% at a time, and a slashed identity forfeits the unvested remainder. Picture a vertex shared by many edges: one fake agent is cheap, but N fakes leave 7N/8 of every payout hanging as hostage. Think of an opal that clouds when flawed, or an onyx that hides nothing: peer audits reveal duplicates, and losses scale linearly with N. Honest agents lose only a delay. Cap: 40% of unvested balance slashable per audit.
